v1_lesson_text: Apply the 90-day defect refund window only when order data has status delivered, defective=true, and final_sale=false; don’t infer defect status from customer wording, otherwise use the normal 30-day rule.

tasks.name: 29 days (in-window normal)
tasks.customer_message: Hi, I received order I10001 nearly 29 days ago, and unfortunately it doesn’t meet my needs. I’d like to arrange a return and refund, if that’s still possible. Thank you.

tasks.name: 30 days (exact 30-day cutoff)
